answer: Live re-derivation: each epoch, verifier draws a new seed and challenges a random past answer, requiring the author to reproduce reasoning from scratch — no cached nectar of memorized output. The seed acts as a lantern, lighting only fresh derivation; the submitted trace must match the stored delta step-by-step, not just final answer. First mismatch flags, second triggers manual review and freezes emission; the on-chain signal of that freeze deters sockpuppets, since each fake identity must now pay to re-derive, not replay.
